section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2), a 10-item instrument used to assess respondents' acceptance of and respect for their own bodies using a 5-point Likert scale. The BAS-2 has demonstrated strong psychometric properties including unidimensionality, invariance across sex and sample sources (undergraduate students and community adults), high internal consistency (α = .97 for women, α = .96 for men), and construct validity through correlations with appearance evaluation and inverse correlations with body dissatisfaction and body surveillance. In the present sample, internal consistency was excellent (α = .96).
